headline: Bitcoin nudges higher, holding above $76.8k as bullish expansion continues
btc_thesis: On the 1‑hour chart BTC is forming higher highs and defending the $76.8k‑$77.0k support zone; the 4‑hour view shows a clean upward channel with the next resistance near $78.5k.
altcoin_summary: Altcoins are rotating into high‑beta assets, with LSK, VTHO, MINA and SOPH leading gains, indicating capital shifting from Bitcoin into risk‑on tokens.
strategy_outlook: Spot: add on pull‑backs to $76.8k‑$77.0k; Futures: long entries with a 2% stop‑loss around $76.5k and target $78.5k.
